Android can pause background apps to save battery. For reliable alerts, allow this app to run in the background. On Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo, Samsung and similar phones, also enable autostart and lock the app in the recent apps list. While the phone is in deep sleep, even instant alerts can be delayed.

This app only talks to your own switchboard, through the Tor network. It has no analytics, no ads and no accounts. The pairing key is stored encrypted on this phone and is excluded from Android backups. Scanning the pairing QR code uses the Google Play services code scanner; you can paste the key instead.
